sections.text: مقدمة

This pump is used to transfer condensate water 
from condenser hot well to dearators to feed pump of HRSG

This document outlines the major maintenance 
procedure (P1) which must be performed 
every 5 Years as indicated by Y5 in above title block.

The first draft 
initiated by Eng. Mahmoud Abou
الفتوح Shata Tested By 
Eng. Ali Abd Elslam 
,and revised by MDEPC quality control engineer 
Abouda Elbana ,accepted by General Director 
Eng. Yosry عبد Elmaqsood, 
ووافق عليها ENG. فاروق Awad رئيس قطاع
طلخا Power Station . This document accepted by 
Eng. Samer Abd El-Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & Quality Control General Director MPIS coordinator & certified 
by Eng. Mohamed Nageb فحص MDEPC والجودة 
رأس التحكم sector inspection

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

Work permit must be issued & qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable saftey category.

Wear safety 
 and helmets equipments as safety healthy safety shoes gloves , etc .

Use safety 
 fence ( Rope ) with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area .

Isolate the 
 circuit breaker of the pump motor .

Disconnect 
 electric terminal of the pump motor .

The pump must 
 be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and suction 
 valves .

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained

sections.text: العمل الذي يتعين القيام به

Check discharge and pump pressure 
 then compare it with the setting value and replace the worn - out components

Measure vibrations level for bearing and compare

 needed)

sections.text: Check alignment and compare it with the setting value and record it

Check flanges for water leakage

Check the pump casing against rust and re-paint it

sections.text: Dissassembly refer to Figure (1)
Disconnect any external auxiliary piping connections

Disconnect the driver shaft from the pump shaft by removing the socket head cap 
screws (364) from the flanged coupling

سيسمح هذا لعمود المضخة والدفاعات بالهبوط أيضًا في حالة الوصلة 
يحتوي على فاصل قم بإزالة المجموعة السفلية من براغي الغطاء والصامولة (363) فقط

Remove 
bolts that attach driver to discharge

Lift driver off 
pump and set on wooden supports

Be sure supports 
are high enough to clear shaft and shaft couplings

Disconnect 
discharge piping from pump

Remove anchor bolts 
(or nut) or if a pump has a suction can remove the nuts attaching discharge head 
to suction can

Lift pump 
vertically unit pump suction clears the base

Cover opening in 
foundation

Lower pump into a 
horizontal position on suitable support and in a suitable area for disassembly

Remove the 
adjusting nut (66) from the pump shaft (left hand threads)

Remove the pump 
half of the flanged coupling (44) with key (46) from shaft pump

Remove slinger 
(346) from shaft unbolt stuffing box (83) and remove from discharge head

The stuffing box 
has (6) rings of packing a lantern ring (29) is in the bottom of the stuffing 
box next or 3 pieces rings of packing (13) with the ends of the packing (13) with the 
ends of the packing staggered around the shaft at 90* from each other

The second lantern ring (29) i next followed by the 
top three rings of packing (13) then the packing gland (17)
Remove suction bell plug (125)

Measure end plug of shaft by pulling all the way 
up until the impellers hit measure and record the distance traveled.

Remove shaft coupling (70)threads 
 are left hand.

يزيل discharge 
 case cap screws (356).

Slide discharge 
 case (309)off shaft.

Remove bowl cap screws(358)and 
 slide top intermediate bowl (310)off shaft.

عمود السحب لأعلى، لذا فإن المكره ليس مقابل الوعاء 
 مقعد باستخدام allen 
 wrench remove ال socket head cap screws(26).
Slide impeller down the shaft 3/16 minimum
Remove the split thrust rings (312).

Slide the impeller off the 
 shaft .

إزالة المفتاح المستقيم (23 
 )from the shaft .

Repeat steps( 20 
 through 25 ) until all inter mediate bowls (310) and impellers (2)have 
 been removed

Slide suction bell (55)off 
 over bottom end of shaft.

All bowl bearings except rubber bearings are 
 pressed into their respective bores و can be 
 either pressed out or machined on the inside diameter until the wall
 يكون thin enough to collapse

sections.text: تقتيش

Iفحص وفحص الدفاعات بحثًا عن علامات الاحتكاك أو chipping 
.

Inspect the ball bearing for damage or change it 
(if it is needed) .
Inspect the wearing rings for wear or damage .

Inspect the shaft for trueness with a dial indicator 
it must be true within (0.004 inches) .
Check shaft run out (not exceed 0.002 inches) .

sections.text:
Assembly refer to 
figure(1)

Check shaft closely for nicks or burrs. Smooth with emery cloth as
required .

Check shaft straightness shaft must be straight within (0.005) 
.

Slide the impeller 
on shaft until the impeller is just above the bottom set of key
seats in the shaft .

Place the 
 straight key in its key seat slide the impeller 
 over the straight key until ال circular key seat 
 is completely above the impeller .

Insert the split 
 thrust rings into the circular key seat with the counter board holes
 بعيد from the impeller .

Alighn the holes in the key s and the impeller 
 insert the socket head cap screws و تشديد 
 سيؤدي ذلك إلى سحب المكره إلى مكانه بالتساوي.

Insert the shaft 
 with the first impeller attached into the suction bearing (323)

شريحة 
 وسيطة bowl(310)into shaft (6)and mate with 
 suction bell (55) on bolted bowl assemblies rotate 
 bowl to align ribs with ribs on suction bell case.

Insert and 
 uniformly tighten cap screws (358) on flanged bowls use heavy chain 
 tongs to tighten threaded bowls .

Repeat steps 3,4,6,&9 
 until all bowls and impeller s are in place .

Slide discharge 
 case (309)over bump shaft.

Install and 
 tighten cap screws (356) or screw discharge case into top bowl if
 threaded

Grasp shaft and 
 rotate by hand to check for binding also check end play by bulling all the 
 way up and measuring distance traveled check this against end play recorded 
 during bowl disassembly.

If 
 يجب تعبئة تجويف محمل الشفط كما هو موضح سابقًا 
 مليئة بالشحوم سابقًا يجب أن يتم ذلك الآن.

بعد
 grease ,remove enough grease when the plug is 
 placed in the bottom of the bell the shaft is not forced up .

Install suction 
 bell plug (125)and tighten.

Screw shaft 
 coupling (70)into shaft.

Check bolts and 
 nuts for tightness , also check threaded discharge 
 case bearing (320) tightness.

On threaded bowls 
 6,and 8models ,after all connections are tight be sure to drill a 3/16hole 
 into each joint then use drive pins (359 )to secure joint.
